user.title: Garmin watch over BLE
user.description: Home Assistant advertises a Bluetooth service on this adapter. Entities carrying the label below are exposed to paired watches. To add a watch, choose Pair in the HassControl BLE app; it then shows up here for approval.

approve.title: Allow Garmin watch {address}?
approve.description: The watch {address} paired over Bluetooth with code **{code}**. Allow it only if your watch showed the same code. It can then control the entities you exposed. Unanswered requests expire after 24 hours.

abort.not_pending: This watch is no longer waiting for approval.
